issue.title: Interleaving tests/test_autonomy_roles.py between tests/test_bead files hides tests/test_bead/conftest.py fixtures
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1tc.4 note #3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); triaged by sase-1tc.land.

Passing these three files to pytest in exactly this order makes every test in the
trailing tests/test_bead file error with `fixture 'conn' not found`, i.e. none of the
tests/test_bead/conftest.py fixtures (conn, project, project_dir, nested_store, ...)
are visible to it:

    pytest -p no:xdist tests/test_bead/test_work_epic_plan.py tests/test_autonomy_roles.py tests/test_bead/test_db.py

Each file passes alone and in other orders, and grouping test_bead files together
stays green. Evidence:
- sase-1tc.4 reproduced it on clean base 150fce3735 in a separate worktree, so it
  predates (and is unrelated to) the beads.db mirror retirement in epic sase-1tc.
- sase-1tc.land independently reproduced it at master afb070580a: 43 x
  `E fixture 'conn' not found` for tests/test_bead/test_db.py in that order (other
  errors in that run were an unbuilt local sase_core_rs and are unrelated).

Root cause is unproven. Suspects: conftest registration when a sibling top-level test
module is collected between two files of the same package (rootdir/import-mode or a
custom collection hook in tests/conftest.py), or test_autonomy_roles.py importing a
module that shadows tests/test_bead/conftest.py. Impact: diff-scoped lanes
(`just test-scoped`) select files in arbitrary order, so a selection that interleaves
these files reports dozens of spurious errors that look like real regressions.
Do not add skips/xfails or reorder selection to hide it; fix fixture visibility.
